headline: Break slid off to Santa Rosa; triangle still too warm to fish
body:
Safety first: a Small Craft Advisory runs through Monday evening for the waters out to Santa Cruz Island including Santa Rosa, and a second one kicks in at 6 PM tonight for the channel and the outer waters through Sunday evening. Isolated thunderstorms are possible south of Point Conception this afternoon. Today is the only workable window — triangle seas 4.5 ft with wind under 8 kn, harbor 3 ft. Sunday is done: 25–27 kn and 9.5 ft in the triangle, 32 kn gusting 37 and 11 ft on the Flats, 11 ft at Osborn and San Nicolas.

The bluefin call is honest and short. The 64–68 band is nowhere inside the highlighted zone — west corner 73.1, east 73.8, south point 73.0, all far warm of the red line. The break has slid west to Santa Rosa Flats at 69.5, cooling to 66.3 Sunday, and that ground is under advisory both days at 20 kn and 6.3 ft today. Osborn (73.6) and San Nicolas (72.8) are warm water and long runs. Neither day is a bluefin day.
